content: FastAPI testing in 2025/2026: sync TestClient (starlette.testclient, built on httpx) is sufficient for most endpoint tests and runs in plain def test_ functions without async ceremony. For testing async-only code paths or lifespan/startup events, use httpx.AsyncClient(transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url='http://test') with @pytest.mark.anyio; the old AsyncClient(app=app) shortcut is deprecated. Use asgi-lifespan's LifespanManager if startup/shutdown events must fire during tests.
